summary: Pass 5/5. The baseline implements and runs a Python Laya moderation gate with a crisp noul and an other-inclusive choice schema, confidence/probability-based automatic-action gating, human-review fallbacks, and preserved actual outputs for ordinary and adversarial states. No credentials or inference endpoints are hard-coded.
